svg.aria-label: Boxes showing one array a = 3 1 4 1 5 and what four ufunc methods make of it: reduce gives 14, add.accumulate gives the running totals 3 4 8 9 14, maximum.accumulate gives 3 3 4 4 5, and add.outer of 1 2 3 with 10 20 gives a 3 by 2 table of sums
